dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になったら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for being here today. We’ll begin when it’s time.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談に来てくださりありがとうございます。初めにご年齢と性別、ご相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you tell me your age and gender, and what you’d like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 中３の息子のことなんですが
dialogue.English: It’s about my son—he’s in his third year of junior high school.

dialogue.content: 部屋に閉じこもることが多くて口をきいてくれないんです
dialogue.English: He's been shutting himself in his room a lot and won't talk to me.

dialogue.content: 中３の息子さんがお部屋にこもってあまり口を聞いてくれないということで、お母さまとしてはとてもご心配ですね。
dialogue.English: So, your son, who is in his third year of junior high, has been staying in his room and isn't speaking to you much. That must be very worrying for you as his mother.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: どの原因かきっかけなど、心当たりがございましたら教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Is there any cause or trigger that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: 入試が終わってからなんです
dialogue.English: It started after his entrance exams were over.

dialogue.content: 高校入試が終わってからということですか？
dialogue.English: You mean after his high school entrance exams?

dialogue.content: 出願のときから親子でぶつかっていたんですが、入試が終わってから口をきいてくれなくなったんです
dialogue.English: We had been clashing since the application period, but after the exams he stopped talking to me.

dialogue.content: 出願したい学校が親子で違っていたということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that mean you and your son disagreed on the school he should apply to?

dialogue.content: 出願の段になって、塾から急に第二志望も無理だから第三志望の高校にしろと言われて
dialogue.English: When it came time to apply, the cram school suddenly told us that even his second choice was out of reach, and that he should apply to his third-choice high school.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それでどうなったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. And what happened then?

dialogue.content: 全員志望校に入学させるととうたった塾にいれたはずだったのに
dialogue.English: We thought we’d enrolled him in a cram school that claimed they get everyone into their chosen schools…

dialogue.content: 本人は第二志望を受けたいと言ったのですが、塾の言う通りに第三志望を受けさせました
dialogue.English: He said he wanted to try for his second choice, but we made him apply to his third choice, just as the cram school said.

dialogue.content: 第三志望なら、そんな厳しい塾になんていかせなければよかった
dialogue.English: If he was just going to go for his third choice, we shouldn't have sent him to such a demanding cram school.

dialogue.content: それはお母様としては、がっかりされたんでしょうね。息子さんも同じお気持ちでおられるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must have been very disappointing for you as his mother. Do you think your son feels the same way?

dialogue.content: 無理やり第三志望にされたことに怒っています
dialogue.English: He's angry that he was forced to go for his third choice.

dialogue.content: 第二でも受かったかもしれなかったのに
dialogue.English: He feels he might have gotten into his second choice.

dialogue.content: 息子さんもお母さまも塾に対して不信感を持たれますよね？そうですよね、やってみないと結果はわかりますんよね。
dialogue.English: It makes sense that both you and your son would feel a sense of distrust towards the cram school, right? I mean, you never know the outcome until you try.

dialogue.content: 塾の全員合格の実績作りのための作戦に乗せられてしまった、私たちが馬鹿だったんです
dialogue.English: We got taken in by their strategy to pad their “everyone passes” record—we were foolish.

dialogue.content: お母様としては塾に利用されたようにお感じなのですね。息子さんはどういう風におっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: So you feel as though you were used by the cram school. What has your son been saying?

dialogue.content: そうだったんだと思い
dialogue.English: He's realized that's what happened,

dialogue.content: 塾も悪いけどお父さんやお母さんだって悪いと言っています
dialogue.English: and he says that while the cram school is to blame, so are his father and I.

dialogue.content: 息子は途中で塾を辞めたいと言っていたんです厳しすぎて付いていけないからと
dialogue.English: My son said he wanted to quit the cram school partway through, saying it was too tough and he couldn't keep up.

dialogue.content: それを、この塾なら合格できるんだから頑張りなさいって本当に馬鹿だった
dialogue.English: And I told him, 'You can get in if you go to this school, so just do your best.' I was such a fool.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。辞めさせてほしいけど辞めさせてもらえなかったので、ご両親にも怒っておられるようにお感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that he's also angry with you and his father because you didn't let him quit when he wanted to.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもお母様としては、それが息子さんの将来の為だと思ってのご判断だったんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: But I imagine you made that decision because you thought it was for the good of your son's future.

dialogue.content: 親のエゴです
dialogue.English: It was parental ego.

dialogue.content: むりやりそんな所に入れて
dialogue.English: Forcing him into a place like that...

dialogue.content: 塾に入る際は息子さんは何か言われましたか？それもお母さまのご判断だったのですか？
dialogue.English: When he was enrolling in the cram school, did your son say anything? Or was that also your decision?

dialogue.content: お父さんが見つけてきて、私が勧めました最初は息子はどこでもいいよって言ってました
dialogue.English: My husband found it, and I recommended it. At first, my son said any place was fine.

dialogue.content: でも途中で辞めたいと泣きそうな顔で頼んできたんですどうしてそれを聴いてあげなかったんだろう
dialogue.English: But partway through, he came to me looking like he was about to cry and begged me to let him quit. Why didn't I listen to him?

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。その時のお母さまはどんなお思いで、続けるように息子さんに言われましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. At that time, what were you thinking when you told your son to continue?

dialogue.content: 目先の合格率100%に騙されました
dialogue.English: I was fooled by the '100% acceptance rate' right in front of my eyes.

dialogue.content: あの塾は嘘ばっかりです
dialogue.English: That cram school is full of lies.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そう書かれていたら第一志望の事だと思ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. If they advertise that, you would naturally assume it means getting into one's first choice school.

dialogue.content: 自分のとこの都合の良いことしかやってないどうしてそんなところに行かせてしまったんだろう
dialogue.English: They only do what's convenient for them. Why did I ever send him to a place like that?

dialogue.content: その時のご判断では最善だと思われたのですね。この先お母さまはどうしていけばいいと思っておられますか？
dialogue.English: At the time, you believed it was the best decision. Looking ahead, what do you think you should do?

dialogue.content: わかりません息子が一切口をきいてくれないんです
dialogue.English: I don't know. My son won't say a single word to me.

dialogue.content: どうすればいいんですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: ごめんなさいあなたのせいではないのに
dialogue.English: I’m sorry—it’s not your fault.

dialogue.content: いいえ、私の事を気にかけてくださりありがとうございます。どうしたらいいかを私とご一緒に考えていきませんか？
dialogue.English: Not at all. Thank you for your concern. Why don't we think about what to do together?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。息子さんは自室から出て来られるときはありますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Are there times when your son comes out of his room?

dialogue.content: トイレや食事の時だけ部屋から出てきますが、黙って食べてます
dialogue.English: He only comes out for the bathroom or for meals, and he eats in silence.

dialogue.content: 風呂には入りません
dialogue.English: He doesn't take baths.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。食事の際に会話はできそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think conversation might be possible during meals?

dialogue.content: 話しかけても、返事をしてくれません
dialogue.English: Even if I speak to him, he doesn’t respond.

dialogue.content: それはお母さまもお辛いでしょうね。
dialogue.English: That must be difficult for you, too.

dialogue.content: 私が悪いんだから仕方ありません
dialogue.English: It’s my fault, so it can’t be helped.

dialogue.content: お母様は何も悪くはありませんよ。一生懸命に息子さんの幸せを願っておられる優しいお母さまだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: You are not to blame at all. I believe you're a kind mother who is earnestly wishing for her son's happiness.

dialogue.content: そうなのかな
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: 私はそう感じていますよ。
dialogue.English: That's how I see it.

dialogue.content: 息子を言いなりにしたいだけかもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe I just want my son to do as I say.

dialogue.content: 思い通りにしたいだけかもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe I just want things my way.

dialogue.content: お母さまはご自身の事をそうお感じでおられるんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel about yourself.

dialogue.content: 以前からああしろ、こうしろって言ってきましたからそれがこんな裏目にでるなんて
dialogue.English: I’ve been telling him, “Do this, do that,” for a long time, and I never imagined it would backfire like this.

dialogue.content: なるほど、今まで息子さんもお母さまのご助言に合わせてこられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, until now, has your son generally gone along with your advice?

dialogue.content: これからはお母さまとしてはどうしていきたいとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: How would you like to proceed from now on?

dialogue.content: はいあまり自分の意見を言う子じゃなかったでも塾のことだけは辞めたいって強く言ってきたんですどうしてそれが聴けなかったんだろう
dialogue.English: Yes, he wasn't a child who usually expressed his own opinions. But he was so adamant about wanting to quit the cram school. Why couldn't I listen to him?

dialogue.content: 私が悪いんですあの子の人生を壊してしまった
dialogue.English: It’s my fault. I’ve ruined his life.

dialogue.content: 意見を言わない息子さんは、お母さまが考えられたことに合わせてこられたのですね。過去の失敗をこれからに生かして、息子さんがいい方向に向かってくださるように、考えてみませんか？
dialogue.English: So your son, who doesn't often express his opinions, has been going along with what you thought was best. Why don't we think about how you can learn from this and help your son move in a better direction?

dialogue.content: どうすればいいんですか
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 息子さんに食事の際に、お母さまの今のお気持ちを伝えるのは出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: During a meal, do you think you could tell your son how you're feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 言っても返事もしてくれないし
dialogue.English: Even if I do, he won't answer me.

dialogue.content: 聞こえてはいますよね？残念なお気持ちは同じだと思いますので、その気持ちをお話しになり、そのうえで、息子さんの気持ちをわかってあげられなかったことにごめんと言ってみるのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: He can hear you, right? I imagine you both share the same sense of disappointment, so how about you talk about that, and then apologize for not understanding how he felt?

dialogue.content: 息子さんが受け入れるのには時間がかかるかもしれませんが、息子さんなりに今回の事を消化して、これからの事を考えてくださるかもしれませんね。どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It may take time for him to accept it, but he may process what happened in his own way and start thinking about the future. What do you think?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: やってみます
dialogue.English: I’ll try.

dialogue.content: どうもありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お母さま、短時間でご納得いかれていないかもしれなせんので、よければまたご相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I know this was a short session, so you might not feel fully resolved. Please feel free to come back for another consultation if you'd like.

dialogue.content: はいよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd appreciate that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はこれで終了させて頂いて大丈夫そうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Would it be alright to end here for today?

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. We'll end the session now.
